message.content:
The value of $20 in British Pounds depends on the current exchange rate, which fluctuates throughout the day. As of the most recent rates (mid‑2024), 1 USD ≈ 0.78 GBP. Using that rate:

\[
\$20 \times 0.78 \;(\text{GBP/USD}) \approx £15.60
\]

So roughly **£15.60**.  

If you need a precise figure for a specific date or time, you can check a reliable financial news source, a bank’s currency converter, or a real‑time FX platform.
